items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: we were playing the Metronome -- the Metropole... and Fud came in one night... We are not talking about Fred Livingston, but there was a guy who burned himself out.

ctx.x: Well, he died. We were playing -- let's see, what would the years have been, in the fifties, maybe '53, '54, we were playing the Metronome -- the Metropole, you remember the jazz spot where we played up on the little stage, and Fud came in one night wearing a big Halloween nose, one of those clown's noses, and came in one night, and I thought, oh, poor Fud, he's gone, and he was standing there and he was almost out of his mind with drunkenness and not long after that they found him down in Skid Row in New York,…
